files.description: Primary EHI export documentation — Word document (docx) titled 'OmniMD 170.315(b)(10) Electronic Health Information Export Version 1.0'. Lists two export mechanisms: C-CDA XML bulk export (20 sections) and FHIR Bulk Data (by reference to g(10)). Single page, no data dictionary or field-level detail.

OpenAPI v1.0 documentation PDF (9 pages). Documents the OmniMD REST API for (g)(7)/(g)(9) — includes API endpoints for Patient Search, Get Patient Data (CDA XML output), Registration, and Authentication. The GetPatientData endpoint returns CDA 2.1 XML with selectable sections matching the EHI export sections. Created 2024-05-10.

Interactive API documentation web page for OmniMD OpenAPI Version 1.0. Covers Introduction, Token authentication, Registration, Patient Search, and Get Patient Data. Contains example API calls and response formats. Same content as the PDF but in interactive HTML form.

ASP.NET Web API Help Page listing all API endpoints (Account, User, Patient, Practice, Values, Audit, Role) with HTTP methods and URL patterns. All descriptions say 'No documentation available' — an unpopulated default scaffold.

Full-page screenshot of the registered URL (RWT page) showing the page layout: OMNIMD V18.0 section with RWT plan/result buttons, OMNIMD V20 section with RWT buttons and the 'ELECTRONIC HEALTH INFORMATION (EHI) EXPORT' button at the bottom.
Full-page screenshot of the Open API page showing API terms and conditions, plus 'Reference for Open API' and 'Download PDF' buttons at the bottom.
